files.role: Atlas Shell registration — side-effect import by main.tsx; calls AppRegistry.register() with Learning app config

public_objects.name: AppRegistry.register call
public_objects.description: Registers appId=learning, label=Learning, basePath=/learning, component=React.lazy(ShellEntry), mobilePrimaryNav=[{id:learning-units, label:Units, path:/learning, order:1}], desktopNav=[{id:learning-units, label:Units, path:/learning, order:1}]

files.role: Shell entry point — default export consumed by React.lazy in shellConfig.ts; owns the React Router <Routes> tree for the Learning tile
Learning tile main list view — fetches training-units, renders sorted unit cards with progress and subtask counts, provides navigation to unit detail and creation

methods.name: LearningPage
methods.purpose: Fetches GET /tasks/training-units on mount; renders loading skeleton, error card, or list of TrainingUnitCards; includes add button navigating to /learning/new

methods.name: TrainingUnitCard
methods.purpose: Renders one training unit card: title, labels chips, priority chip, progress bar (completed_child_count/total_child_count), last activity date (last_child_completed_at), status badge

files.role: Training unit detail view — shows parsed potential subtasks (unchecked/activated), child training_session tasks with duration editing, and unit edit controls

methods.name: UnitDetailPage
methods.purpose: Reads :unitId from route params; fetches unit from GET /tasks/training-units (or single-task GET) and child tasks; renders PotentialSubtaskList and ChildTaskList; handles activation via activateSubtask()

methods.name: PotentialSubtaskList
methods.purpose: Renders unchecked lines with 'Create task' button and activated lines with checkmark and task link; shows spinner on the activating line

methods.name: ChildTaskList
args: onDurationChange: (taskId: string, minutes: number | null) => Promise<void>
methods.purpose: Renders child training_session tasks with status, title, and inline actual_duration_minutes editing

files.role: Form to create a new training_unit task — fields: title (required), description (with optional ## Potential Subtasks guidance), priority, labels; posts to TaskTracker; redirects to /learning on success

methods.name: CreateTrainingUnitPage
methods.purpose: Renders creation form; on submit calls POST /tasks with task_type=training_unit; on success navigates to /learning

files.role: Pure functions for parsing and updating the ## Potential Subtasks markdown section in task.description — no React dependency; unit-testable in isolation

public_objects.name: POTENTIAL_SUBTASKS_HEADING
public_objects.description: String constant '## Potential Subtasks' used as the section delimiter

methods.name: parseSubtasks
methods.purpose: Extracts lines from the ## Potential Subtasks section; classifies each as unchecked ('- [ ] <title>') or activated ('- [x] <title> → task: <uuid>'); returns empty arrays if section absent or description null

methods.name: activateSubtaskLine
methods.purpose: Returns updated description string with the first matching '- [ ] <lineText>' replaced by '- [x] <lineText> → task: <taskId>'; leaves description unchanged if line not found

files.role: TypeScript interface definitions for Learning tile domain types used across frontend files

public_objects.name: TrainingUnitRow
public_objects.description: Interface: { id: string; title: string; description: string | null; status: string; priority: string; labels: { id: string; name: string }[]; last_child_completed_at: string | null; completed_child_count: number; total_child_count: number; actual_duration_minutes: number | null; completed_at: string | null }

public_objects.name: ChildTaskRow
public_objects.description: Interface: { id: string; title: string; status: string; priority: string; actual_duration_minutes: number | null; completed_at: string | null; task_type: string }
